# Error catalog

Stable diagnostic codes for conforming parsers and validators. **Generated** from `shared/language-model.json`.

Normative prose and message requirements: [`docs/full-spec.md` §24](../../full-spec.md#24--error-catalog).

## Errors (`PDL-E`)

| Code | Name | Summary |
|------|------|---------|
| **PDL-E001** | `unexpected-token` | Unexpected token in the current parse context (also used for removed keywords like `interaction` / classic `let`). |
| **PDL-E002** | `circular-import` | Import chain forms a cycle. |
| **PDL-E003** | `duplicate-symbol` | Two top-level declarations share a name in the same namespace. |
| **PDL-E004** | `unknown-token-type` | Unknown TokenType on a primitive/semantic. |
| **PDL-E005** | `token-type-mismatch` | Token RHS incompatible with declared TokenType. |
| **PDL-E006** | `frame-prop-type-mismatch` | Frame / typeStyle property value has the wrong type. |
| **PDL-E007** | `unresolved-reference` | Identifier does not resolve to a token, param, or frame id. |
| **PDL-E008** | `unresolved-type-style` | `style = Name` does not match a typeStyle. |
| **PDL-E010** | `invalid-condition-operand` | Condition compares unsupported types or operators. |
| **PDL-E011** | `unknown-frame-property` | Property not defined on that frame kind / typeStyle. |
| **PDL-E012** | `invalid-frame-prop-target` | Unknown frame id, wrong-kind prop, or illegal fixture param ref. |
| **PDL-E013** | `circular-token-reference` | Token RHS cycle. |
| **PDL-E014** | `duplicate-fixture-label` | Duplicate example label in fixtures. |
| **PDL-E016** | `extend-unknown-target` | extend names a missing component. |
| **PDL-E017** | `quoted-hex-color` | Quoted string used where unquoted hex Color is required. |
| **PDL-E018** | `reserved-word-as-identifier` | Reserved word used as a user identifier. |
| **PDL-E019** | `invalid-override-target` | Forward reference to undeclared let frame id. |
| **PDL-E020** | `invalid-constructor-arg` | Constructor / pack argument error. |
| **PDL-E021** | `duplicate-let-frame-id` | Duplicate let / letInstance id in a component. |
| **PDL-E022** | `unknown-protocol` | Unknown protocol name. |
| **PDL-E023** | `unknown-foreach-list` | ForEach names a non-list param. |
| **PDL-E024** | `unknown-emit-channel` | Unknown emit channel. |
| **PDL-E025** | `invalid-foreach-binding` | Invalid ForEach derived bind. |
| **PDL-E026** | `foreach-chrome-unimplemented` | before/between/after before B6. |
| **PDL-E027** | `emit-payload-mismatch` | Emit capture / fire arity or types mismatch. |
| **PDL-E028** | `ambient-as-emit-capture` | Host inbound used as child emit capture. |
| **PDL-E029** | `declared-as-host-channel` | Declared emit used as host inbound channel. |
| **PDL-E030** | `interaction-missing-host-protocol` | Host channel/verb without effective host conformance. |
| **PDL-E031** | `host-protocol-as-slot-type` | Host protocol used as slot/param type. |
| **PDL-E032** | `invalid-protocol-requires` | Invalid requires clause on a protocol. |
| **PDL-E033** | `unknown-host-verb` | Unknown host verb in a handler. |
| **PDL-E034** | `array-slot-dotted-override` | Dotted override on an array slot; use ForEach. |
| **PDL-E035** | `foreach-without-mount` | ForEach list never mounted via children. |
| **PDL-E036** | `list-emit-capture` | Emit capture on a list param; use ForEach binder. |
| **PDL-E037** | `unknown-component` | Unknown component name. |
| **PDL-E038** | `mixed-condition-operators` | Mixed && and || without parentheses. |
| **PDL-E039** | `unknown-param-type` | Unknown param type; Boolean → use Bool. |
| **PDL-E040** | `param-type-mismatch` | Param default / kwarg / fixture type mismatch. |
| **PDL-E041** | `unknown-sample-path` | Unknown samples bank/entry/field or bank/component name collision. |

## Warnings (`PDL-W`)

| Code | Name | Summary |
|------|------|---------|
| **PDL-W001** | `param-shadows-token` | Param name matches a token; param wins in body. |
| **PDL-W002** | `primitive-token-in-component` | Component references a primitive token directly. |
| **PDL-W003** | `literal-opacity-in-library` | Raw opacity literal where an Opacity token is preferred. |
| **PDL-W004** | `unreadable-schemaVersion` | Unknown schemaVersion on catalogue/manifest input. |
| **PDL-W005** | `unknown-key-in-usage` | usage block key other than description. |
| **PDL-W006** | `empty-component` | Root frame has no children and no content props. |
| **PDL-W007** | `unreachable-override-branch` | Unreachable if/else if branch. |
